title: A lost-shell command of any writable session marks every open check on the host as overlapped, across repositories, silently
outcome: A lost-shell command of any writable session marks every open check on the host as overlapped, across repositories, silently
acceptance: A command of a session whose shell TermAl cannot follow no longer marks every open check on the host: when each of its line's directory changes names an absolute literal target and nothing on the line may hide a change, it marks only the open checks whose worktree is among the places that shell may be — where it was, where a pending move leads, and those targets, at most 32 places; any other change counts in every worktree, for that command and for the lost shell's later commands.
